2. The short facts of the case is that, the plaintiff appellant filed the suit for declaration of title stating, inter alia, in short, that, the owner of the suit land was one Dukhai Mondal who died before the CS operation leaving behind three sons namely, Hajari Mondal, Bajari Mondal and Brojanath Mondal. The said three sons being in need of money mortgaged the suit land including the other lands for a sum of Taka 200.00 to one Rahim Boksha Bepari by a registered kot kabala dated 2-2-1907 and surrendered possession in favour of Rahim Boksha Bepari. There was a stipulation in the said kot kabala that, Rahim Baksha Bepari, the mortgagee, will enjoy the possession of the properties in the kot kabala for nine years and if the mortgagor fails to redeem the mortgage within nine years the kot kabala will be treated as Saf kabala (sale kabala) the mortgagee shall be entitled to mutate his name and will be absolute owner of the mortgaged properties. CS Khatian No. 504 was made in the name of Bazari Mondal and dag No. 1130 of the said khatian measuring 0.68 acres out of which 0.26 acres is the suit land. Rahim Baksha Bepari has been in possession of 0.68 acres of land of this plot without any obstruction. SA khatian was prepared in the name of Rahim Baksha Bepari and Moktar Hossain and others. Since 1907 Rahim Boksha has been enjoying the mortgage property free from any encumbrance and without any obstruction from anybody, Rahim Bosha Bepari died leaving behind Foez Boksha Mia, Haji Rahman Boksha and others as his heirs who became the owner of the mortgaged property. Foez Boksha Mia and Haji Rahman Boksha sold 0.26 acres of land to the plaintiff by a registered saf kabala dated 17-4-1967 and made over possession to her. They sold the 42 decimals of land to one Halima Khatoon and gave her possession. The plaintiff has been enjoying the property by mutating his name and by paying taxes to the Government and Municipality, etc. 

 8. We have heard the learned Advocate for the appellant Mr M Shamsul Alam and perused the judgment and evidence and Exhibits filed in this case. The plaintiff has produced her original kot kabala dated 2-2-1907 which has been marked as Exhibit 1 and other documents including Khatians and rent receipts etc. and her saf kabala dated 17-4-1967 which has been marked as Ext. 10. She also examined 5 witnesses in the case who deposed that she has been in possession of the suit land. The learned trial Court after discussing the evidence of the plaintiff''s witnesses and Exhibits 6 to 6 'Ka' Exhibit 7 and the order of the ADC (Rev) found possession of the plaintiff in the suit land.
